NOTE
**Still not ready: the test fix is a separate commit that belongs in the first one**

New: The author pushed 12 times since the label, fixed the issue-comment/PR-comment mix-up they reported, and added a Gitea test change. CI passes. Missing: the "fix test for PR comment" commit needs to be squashed into the first commit, because that commit changes behavior and breaks the test on its own.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave it unassigned for now. Once the commits are squashed, remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", and assign laurynmm.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the updates! Please squash the "fix test for PR comment" commit into the first commit, so each commit passes tests on its own (see the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html)), and then we can get this reviewed.
```
